input.quote: Customer commits to purchase at least USD 2,000,000 of Services in each of the next three years on a take-or-pay basis, without reduction or termination rights.
input.rationale: Section 2.1 imposes a USD 2,000,000 annual take-or-pay commitment on Customer with no reduction or termination rights, so any shortfall becomes a fixed sum payable by us for Services we never receive — economically a liquidated damages/minimum-fee penalty against Customer, which the rule prohibits (walk-away territory since it is untied to actual loss and survives even where we would otherwise have termination rights). It also conflicts with § 7.1 (no minimum-use charge) and § 12.3 (Customer has made no minimum-volume commitment). Redline removes the Customer-payable commitment; the comment offers the fallback of an early-termination fee capped at three months' Fees.

proposal.summary: Delete the take-or-pay minimum commitment in § 2.1 and confirm no Customer-payable shortfall, penalty, or minimum charge.
proposal.comment: [Playbook] We do not accept liquidated damages or penalties payable by us, and the § 2.1 take-or-pay commitment (USD 2,000,000 per year with no reduction or termination rights) operates as exactly that on any shortfall. We have replaced it so we pay only for Services we order, consistent with § 7.1 and § 12.3, which already confirm no minimum-use or minimum-volume commitment; if a volume-based discount matters to you, we can discuss tiered pricing or an early-termination fee capped at three months' Fees as the sole liquidated amount.

ops.oldText: Customer commits to purchase at least USD 2,000,000 of Services in each of the next three years on a take-or-pay basis, without reduction or termination rights.
ops.newText: Customer has no minimum-purchase, take-or-pay, or committed-volume obligation. Customer shall pay only for Services it orders under an Order Form and owes no liquidated damages, penalty, shortfall payment, or minimum or early-termination charge for Services it does not order, use, or continue. Customer's reduction and termination rights under this Agreement and each Order Form are preserved.
